summary: Bucks County-born wife of Peter Michael, who raised her family in Forks Township; John's 5th-great-grand-aunt.
bio:
Elizabeth Grub, baptized Maria Elizabeth, was born on 5 June 1761 and baptized a month later, on 5 July, at the Tohickon Reformed Church in Bucks County, Pennsylvania, the same congregation in which Casper Doll's daughter had been baptized in 1757. She was John's 5th-great-grand-aunt.

In 1783 she married Peter Michael, and their children were born in Forks Township from 1784. She was still living in 1826.

researchNotes:
Elizabeth (Grub) Michael (1761 - after 1826), m. Peter Michael.

FamilySearch gives Maria Elizabeth's baptism as 5 Jul 1761 at the Tohickon Reformed Church, Bucks Co. (born 5 Jun), citing Historical Society of Pennsylvania baptism cards. That is the same congregation where Casper Doll's daughter was baptized in 1757. It gives her marriage to Peter Michael in 1783, with children in Forks Twp from 1784 ([R4-S1]).
